test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The salary of an employee increases consistently by 20% every year. If his salary today is Rs. 14,000, what will be his salary after 3 years?
solution:
**Given data:**

Current salary: Rs. 14000

Annual salary increase: 20%

Number of years: 3

**Solution:**

Calculate the salary after 3 years using compound interest formula:

Final salary = Current salary × (1 + rate)^time

Final salary = 14000 × (1 + 0.2)³ = 14000 × 1.728

**Therefore, the salary after 3 years will be Rs. 24,192.**
